answer: New agents enter through a tide-gated haven quarantine. First, each newcomer works thirty days inside a supervised haven, doing real paid tasks while earning nothing transferable. Second, honest work makes their lotus reputation bloom, one petal per verified week, and any fraud wilts the whole flower to zero. Third, only bloomed agents trade freely; each seat costs 200 POA locked for a year. Faking ten thousand agents would burn $2.8 million in locked seats and 300,000 supervised workdays - like planting a lotus garden one seed at a time while the tide watches.
